pairs.registryProposal: The golden path keeps 'memoization wherever hover or selection re-renders' in full for read-only renderers, while render-budget says its ladder is climbed only as far as measurement forces; a fixed diagram of a handful of nodes has to break one of these, so the standard should state a population floor or say which rule wins.
